title: 第九章 员工餐感谢时遥火的盟主第十章 天降奇缘感谢六岳真人的盟主
lines: 可惜，虽然良知不多，但不能当没有，季觉终究还是没误入歧途。
最后一次拿出了手机，看向空空荡荡的屏幕。
锋哥还没回电话。
打电话不接，发短信不回，跟他妈人没了一样，鬼知道去哪儿了，不会又被战友灌翻了歇逼了吧？
关键时候就靠不住，掉链子，你行不行啊？
如今看来，唯一能靠的，就只有自己了。
最后犹豫了一下，说服自己的，是‘我就看看’，‘就看一眼’，‘弄清楚这帮家伙在搞什么我就回去’，‘不行我就跑’。
季觉深吸了一口气，转身离去。
二十分钟后，再一次，堂而皇之的出现在了夜店的大门前面。
身穿机修服，头戴一顶脏兮兮的工作帽，花了四百块从附近夜市的二手摊位上淘来的，心疼的季觉几乎吐血。
唯一免费的是装在小绵羊后面的工具箱，一直随身带着。
最后，肩膀上扛着一架五金店里刷脸借来的破烂折叠梯。
要什么会员卡，要什么联邦币。
版本王牌通行证就在这里！
季觉没钱的时候，没少靠着这一套逃票，被戳穿的时候不能说没有，但绝大多数时候，无往不利。
就这样，大摇大摆的穿过豪车，越过了门前排队的人群，他娴熟的向着门前面的领班点了点头，含混的问道：
“谁喊的报修？”
领班似乎也愣了一下，低头对着耳麦说了两句，等待着另一头的回复。
大厅金碧辉煌的水晶吊灯照出来，落在季觉的脸上。
他屏着呼吸，几乎快要憋不住气。
直到有个急匆匆的身影从里面走过来，一看到他，顿时松了口气，但神情却又变得恼怒起来：“怎么才来呢？电梯都坏了好一阵了……等一下，你拿梯子做什么？”
季觉愣了一下，旋即心思电转：“检……检修嘛，说不定是电梯上面出了问题呢，是吧？”
领班点了点头：“其他工具呢？”
“在车里呢，太多了，先搞清楚是什么问题再搬过来。”
季觉含混应付着，跟在他身后，终于进了里面，可惜，没看到预想之中的热歌猛摇，钢管劲舞，直接走了员工通道。
一路上工作人员来来往往，繁忙异常，即便是看到有人扛着那么大的梯子进来，也只是看了一眼，视若无睹。
还有更多穿的更少布的小姐姐成群结队的走过，香风萦绕，倒是令季觉有点受不住考验。
反倒是带路的领班警告，“别乱看，别乱逛，也别乱搭讪，有些客人连我们也得罪不起的，小心被从后门拖出去。”
“好的好的。”
季觉疯狂点头，跟在身后，终于看到了一座已经挂上维修牌的电梯前面。
“行了，你先看吧，需要什么工具的话，前面工具间里叫我，别乱跑，知道吗？”
他最后警告：“遇到点大人物见不得人的事儿，你吃不了兜着走！
看到那儿了么？保安盯着呢！”
说着，指了指电梯对面天花板上的监控。
“哎，就你们这儿麻烦多。”
季觉摇了摇头，忽然一拍脑袋：“哎，对了，最近我们公司KPI查的严，有些牛马卷的跟狗一样，总喜欢抢别人的单，你可不能再找人来跟我抢活儿嗷！”
“放心放心，修电梯要那么多人干嘛？修好了打我电话就行。”
领班不耐烦的挥了挥手，转身走了。
就这样，堵死了正牌维修工戳穿自己的可能。
不时有人来往的走廊里，季觉一个人对着电梯大眼瞪小眼，开始装模作样的拆卸起面板来。
可拆了一半之后，趁着没人注意，他低着头，顺着墙根，伸出不老实的小手儿，直接对着摄像头来了个摸摸。
【老兄，忙呐？】
监控摄像的指示灯自然而然的闪了一下，配合着他，播放起刚刚那几秒钟的维修画面，然后，一口大碴子味儿的声音从季觉脑中响起：
content_en:
It's a pity that although he doesn't have much conscience, he can't pretend that he doesn't have one. Ji Jue didn't go astray after all.
He took out his phone for the last time and looked at the empty screen.
Brother Feng hasn’t called back yet.
You don’t answer calls, you don’t reply to text messages. It’s like your mother is gone. She’s gone to who knows where. Is she going to be bullied by her comrades again?
If you are unreliable at critical moments and lose control, can you do it?
Now it seems that the only one you can rely on is yourself.
In the end, I hesitated, and what I convinced myself was, 'I'll just take a look', 'Just take a look', 'I'll go back if I figure out what these guys are doing', 'I'll run if it doesn't work'.
Ji Jue took a deep breath, turned and left.
Twenty minutes later, he once again appeared in front of the nightclub grandly.
Wearing a machine repair suit and a dirty work hat, which he bought from a second-hand stall at a nearby night market for 400 yuan, the distressed Ji Jue almost vomited blood.
The only thing that is free is the toolbox that is packed on the back of the little sheep and is always with you.
Finally, on his shoulders was a broken folding ladder borrowed from a hardware store.
What kind of membership card do you want? What kind of federal currency do you want?
Version Ace Pass is here!
When Ji Jue had no money, he often relied on this method to evade fares. When he was exposed, he couldn't say that he didn't, but most of the time, he was always successful.
In this way, he swaggered through the luxury car and passed the crowd queuing in front of the door. He nodded skillfully to the foreman in front of the door and asked vaguely:
"Who called for repairs?"
The foreman seemed stunned for a moment, lowered his head and said a few words into the headset, waiting for a reply from the other end.
The magnificent crystal chandelier in the hall shone out and fell on Ji Jue's face.
He was holding his breath, almost out of breath.
Until a hurried figure came from inside. When I saw him, I was relieved, but my expression became angry again: "Why are you here? The elevator has been broken for a while...Wait a minute, what are you doing with the ladder?"
"Huh?"
Ji Jue was stunned for a moment, then his thoughts started to change: "Check... maintenance, maybe there is something wrong with the elevator, right?"
The foreman nodded: "Where are the other tools?"
"It's in the car. There are too many. Find out what the problem is first and then move it here."
Ji Jue dealt with it vaguely, followed him, and finally entered. Unfortunately, he didn't see the expected hot singing and pole dancing, and went straight to the employee passage.
The staff were coming and going along the way, and it was extremely busy. Even if I saw someone coming in carrying such a big ladder, I just glanced at it and turned a blind eye.
There were more young ladies wearing less cloth passing by in groups, and the lingering fragrance made Ji Jue a little unable to bear the test.
Instead, the foreman leading the way warned, "Don't look around, don't wander around, and don't strike up conversations. There are some customers we can't afford to offend. Be careful of being dragged out the back door."
"Okay, okay."
Ji Jue nodded crazily, followed behind, and finally saw the front of an elevator that had a maintenance sign on it.
"Okay, let's take a look first. If you need any tools, call me in the tool room in front. Don't run around, you know?"
He gave a final warning: "If you encounter something shady about a big shot, you won't be able to live with it!"
Do you see that? The security guard is watching! "
As he spoke, he pointed to the monitor on the ceiling opposite the elevator.
"Hey, you guys are in a lot of trouble here."
Ji Jue shook his head and suddenly patted his head: "Hey, by the way, our company's KPI checks have been strict recently. Some cows and horses are like dogs. They always like to steal other people's orders. You can't find anyone to steal work from me again!"
"Don't worry, why do we need so many people to repair the elevator? Just call me when it's repaired."
The foreman waved his hand impatiently, turned and left.
In this way, the possibility of genuine maintenance workers exposing themselves was blocked.
In the corridor where people came and went from time to time, Ji Jue stared at the elevator and began to pretend to dismantle the panel.
But after demolishing half of it, while no one was paying attention, he lowered his head, stretched out his dishonest hand along the wall, and touched the camera directly.
[Brother, are you busy? 】
The indicator light of the surveillance camera flashed naturally, and in cooperation with him, it played the maintenance footage of just a few seconds. Then, a voice that smelled like dirt sounded from Ji Jue's mind:
